```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggthemes)
library(janitor)
library(writexl)
```


# Load Data - UTK Knoxville


```{r}
utkUsage <- list.files(pattern = '2022-Jan', full.names = TRUE)

for(i in 1:length(utkUsage)){
  reportType <- str_split_1(utkUsage[i], "_")[2]
  datafile <- read_tsv(utkUsage[i], skip = 13, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    mutate(University = 'Knoxville Main')
  assign(paste0("utk_usage_", reportType), datafile)
}
```



# Load Data - UT Chattanooga


```{r}
utcUsage <- list.files(pattern = 'wiley', full.names = TRUE)

for(i in 1:length(utcUsage)){
  reportType <- str_split_1(utcUsage[i], "_")[2]
  year <- str_split_1(utcUsage[i], "_")[3]
  datafile <- read_tsv(utcUsage[i], skip = 13, show_col_types = FALSE)
  assign(paste0("utc_usage_", reportType, '_', year), datafile)
}
```




## Combine Like File Types for Each Year - UTC



### DR

```{r}

         Total_Usage = ifelse(is.na(Reporting_Period_Total.x) == FALSE, Reporting_Period_Total.x, 0) +

                       ifelse(is.na(Reporting_Period_Total) == FALSE, Reporting_Period_Total, 0)) |>
```

# Load Data - Preston Medical Center


```{r, warning = FALSE}
prestonUsage <- list.files(pattern = 'Preston_Wiley', full.names = TRUE)

for(i in 1:length(prestonUsage)){
  reportType <- str_split_1(prestonUsage[i], "-")[2]
  startYear <- substr(str_split_1(prestonUsage[i], "-")[3], 4, 7)
  endYear <- substr(str_split_1(prestonUsage[i], "-")[4], 4, 7)
  datafile <- read_excel(prestonUsage[i], skip = 13)
  assign(paste0("preston_usage_", reportType, '_', startYear, '_', endYear), datafile)
}
```

# Load Data - UT Health Science Center


```{r, warning = FALSE}
hscUsage <- list.files(pattern = 'UTHSC', full.names = TRUE)

for(i in 1:length(hscUsage)){
  reportType <- case_when(
    paste0(str_split_1(hscUsage[i], " ")[1], str_split_1(hscUsage[i], " ")[2]) == './BookAccess' ~ 'TR_B2',
    paste0(str_split_1(hscUsage[i], " ")[1], str_split_1(hscUsage[i], " ")[2]) == './DatabaseMaster' ~ 'DR',
    paste0(str_split_1(hscUsage[i], " ")[1], str_split_1(hscUsage[i], " ")[2]) == './JournalAccess' ~ 'TR_J2',
    paste0(str_split_1(hscUsage[i], " ")[1], str_split_1(hscUsage[i], " ")[2]) == './Journalusage' & str_split_1(hscUsage[i], " ")[4] == 'access' ~ 'TR_J3',
    paste0(str_split_1(hscUsage[i], " ")[1], str_split_1(hscUsage[i], " ")[2]) == './Journalusage' & str_split_1(hscUsage[i], " ")[4] == 'YOP' ~ 'TR_J4',
    paste0(str_split_1(hscUsage[i], " ")[1], str_split_1(hscUsage[i], " ")[2]) == './PlatformMaster' ~ 'PR',
    paste0(str_split_1(hscUsage[i], " ")[1], str_split_1(hscUsage[i], " ")[2]) == './TitleMaster' ~ 'TR',
    .default = 'NA')
  wordCount <- length(str_split(hscUsage[i], " ")[[1]])
  year <- str_split_1(hscUsage[i], " ")[(wordCount - 1)]
  datafile <- read_tsv(hscUsage[i], skip = 13)
  assign(paste0("uthsc_usage_", reportType, '_', year), datafile)
}
```

# Import the Journal List and Journal Information from Wiley's Website


```{r}
read_excel_allsheets <- function(filename, tibble = FALSE) {
    sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(filename)
    x <- lapply(sheets, function(X) readxl::read_excel(filename, sheet = X))
    if(!tibble) x <- lapply(x, as.data.frame)
    names(x) <- sheets
    x
}

wileyInfo <- read_excel_allsheets('Journal Full Breakdown Information.xlsx')
```



```{r}
skipRows <- c(3, 0, 0, 0, 0, 3, 1, 0, 0)

for(sheet in 1:length(wileyInfo)){
  if(skipRows[sheet] == 0 & (sheet < 3 | sheet > 5)){
    next
  }
  else if(skipRows[sheet] != 0){
    wileyInfo[[sheet]] <- wileyInfo[[sheet]][-c(1:skipRows[sheet]),] |>
      row_to_names(row_number = 1)
  }
  else{
    wileyInfo[[sheet]] <- wileyInfo[[sheet]] |>
      row_to_names(row_number = 1)
  }
}

wileyInfo
```


LIST OF NAMES OF WILEY SHEETS, IN ORDER (all grammar matches the sheet itself):

1. 2025 Subscription journals (the main list with all journal information)
2. Update (any updates made to the sheet)
3. Take overs (Any new journals Wiley has taken over)
4. New Starts (New journals not previously in Wiley list)
5. Free to Read (All Free to Read journals, and thus have no cost)
6. Other Changes (Talks about Open Access moves, Online Only moves, Name Changes, Change in Number of Publications in a Year, etc.)
7. No longer published (All titles removed in 2025 and whether they have perpetual access or not, along with their old collections)
8. Free_OA (A list of OA journals)
9. Embargo (All journals with an embargo, and how long that embargo is)




```{r}
excel_sheets('Journal Full Breakdown Information.xlsx')
```

## Grand Total Usage


```{r}
totalUsage <- DR |>
  filter(Metric_Type == 'Unique_Item_Requests') |>
  mutate(Database = case_when(
    Database == 'Cochrane Clinical Answers' ~ 'Clinical Answers',
    Database == 'Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews' ~ 'Systematic Reviews',
    Database == 'The Cochrane Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL)' ~ 'Controlled Trials'
  ))

totalUsage
```



```{r}
ggplot(totalUsage, aes(x = Database, y = Total_Usage, fill = Location)) +
  geom_bar(position = 'dodge', stat = 'identity') +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = 'Set1') +
  labs(x = 'Database', y = 'Unique Item Requests', title = 'Wiley Usage by Database and Campus') +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 18,
                                  color = '#4b4b4b',
                                  face = 'bold')) +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 12,
                                   color = '#4b4b4b',
```

```{r}
trF <- left_join(TR_J4, fullInfo, by = c('Online_ISSN' = 'Digital ISSN', 'Title' = 'Title.x')) |>

TR_J4_Complete <- data.frame()

titles <- unique(trF$Title)
locations <- unique(trF$Location)


for(i in 1:length(titles)){

  }
  for(j in 1:length(locations)){

    location <- locations[j]
    titleData <- trF |>
      filter(Title == title & Location == location)

    if(dim(titleData)[1] == 0){

    }

    
    oneTitle <- titleData |>
      select(Title, Location, YOP,
             `Jan-2022`, `Feb-2022`, `Mar-2022`, `Apr-2022`, `May-2022`, `Jun-2022`, `Jul-2022`, `Aug-2022`, `Sep-2022`, `Oct-2022`, `Nov-2022`, `Dec-2022`,

             `Jan-2024`, `Feb-2024`, `Mar-2024`, `Apr-2024`, `May-2024`, `Jun-2024`, `Jul-2024`, `Aug-2024`, `Sep-2024`, `Oct-2024`, `Nov-2024`, `Dec-2024`) |>
      mutate(`Jan-2022` = ifelse(is.na(`Jan-2022`) == FALSE, `Jan-2022`, 0),
       `Feb-2022` = ifelse(is.na(`Feb-2022`) == FALSE, `Feb-2022`, 0),
       `Mar-2022` = ifelse(is.na(`Mar-2022`) == FALSE, `Mar-2022`, 0),
       `Apr-2022` = ifelse(is.na(`Apr-2022`) == FALSE, `Apr-2022`, 0),
       `May-2022` = ifelse(is.na(`May-2022`) == FALSE, `May-2022`, 0),
       `Jun-2022` = ifelse(is.na(`Jun-2022`) == FALSE, `Jun-2022`, 0),
       `Jul-2022` = ifelse(is.na(`Jul-2022`) == FALSE, `Jul-2022`, 0),
       `Aug-2022` = ifelse(is.na(`Aug-2022`) == FALSE, `Aug-2022`, 0),
       `Sep-2022` = ifelse(is.na(`Sep-2022`) == FALSE, `Sep-2022`, 0),
       `Oct-2022` = ifelse(is.na(`Oct-2022`) == FALSE, `Oct-2022`, 0),
       `Nov-2022` = ifelse(is.na(`Nov-2022`) == FALSE, `Nov-2022`, 0),
       `Dec-2022` = ifelse(is.na(`Dec-2022`) == FALSE, `Dec-2022`, 0),
       `Jan-2023` = ifelse(is.na(`Jan-2023`) == FALSE, `Jan-2023`, 0),
       `Feb-2023` = ifelse(is.na(`Feb-2023`) == FALSE, `Feb-2023`, 0),
       `Mar-2023` = ifelse(is.na(`Mar-2023`) == FALSE, `Mar-2023`, 0),
       `Apr-2023` = ifelse(is.na(`Apr-2023`) == FALSE, `Apr-2023`, 0),
       `May-2023` = ifelse(is.na(`May-2023`) == FALSE, `May-2023`, 0),
       `Jun-2023` = ifelse(is.na(`Jun-2023`) == FALSE, `Jun-2023`, 0),
       `Jul-2023` = ifelse(is.na(`Jul-2023`) == FALSE, `Jul-2023`, 0),
       `Aug-2023` = ifelse(is.na(`Aug-2023`) == FALSE, `Aug-2023`, 0),
       `Sep-2023` = ifelse(is.na(`Sep-2023`) == FALSE, `Sep-2023`, 0),
       `Oct-2023` = ifelse(is.na(`Oct-2023`) == FALSE, `Oct-2023`, 0),
       `Nov-2023` = ifelse(is.na(`Nov-2023`) == FALSE, `Nov-2023`, 0),
       `Dec-2023` = ifelse(is.na(`Dec-2023`) == FALSE, `Dec-2023`, 0),
       `Jan-2024` = ifelse(is.na(`Jan-2024`) == FALSE, `Jan-2024`, 0),
       `Feb-2024` = ifelse(is.na(`Feb-2024`) == FALSE, `Feb-2024`, 0),
       `Mar-2024` = ifelse(is.na(`Mar-2024`) == FALSE, `Mar-2024`, 0),
       `Apr-2024` = ifelse(is.na(`Apr-2024`) == FALSE, `Apr-2024`, 0),
       `May-2024` = ifelse(is.na(`May-2024`) == FALSE, `May-2024`, 0),
       `Jun-2024` = ifelse(is.na(`Jun-2024`) == FALSE, `Jun-2024`, 0),
       `Jul-2024` = ifelse(is.na(`Jul-2024`) == FALSE, `Jul-2024`, 0),
       `Aug-2024` = ifelse(is.na(`Aug-2024`) == FALSE, `Aug-2024`, 0),
       `Sep-2024` = ifelse(is.na(`Sep-2024`) == FALSE, `Sep-2024`, 0),
       `Oct-2024` = ifelse(is.na(`Oct-2024`) == FALSE, `Oct-2024`, 0),
       `Nov-2024` = ifelse(is.na(`Nov-2024`) == FALSE, `Nov-2024`, 0),
       `Dec-2024` = ifelse(is.na(`Dec-2024`) == FALSE, `Dec-2024`, 0)) |>
      mutate(usage22 = `Jan-2022` + `Feb-2022` + `Mar-2022` + `Apr-2022` + `May-2022` + `Jun-2022` + `Jul-2022` + `Aug-2022` + `Sep-2022` + `Oct-2022` + `Nov-2022` + `Dec-2022`,
             usage23 = `Jan-2023` + `Feb-2023` + `Mar-2023` + `Apr-2023` + `May-2023` + `Jun-2023` + `Jul-2023` + `Aug-2023` + `Sep-2023` + `Oct-2023` + `Nov-2023` + `Dec-2023`,
             usage24 = `Jan-2024` + `Feb-2024` + `Mar-2024` + `Apr-2024` + `May-2024` + `Jun-2024` + `Jul-2024` + `Aug-2024` + `Sep-2024` + `Oct-2024` + `Nov-2024` + `Dec-2024`,
             Total_Usage = `Jan-2022` + `Feb-2022` + `Mar-2022` + `Apr-2022` + `May-2022` + `Jun-2022` + `Jul-2022` + `Aug-2022` + `Sep-2022` + `Oct-2022` + `Nov-2022` + `Dec-2022` +`Jan-2023` + `Feb-2023` + `Mar-2023` + `Apr-2023` + `May-2023` + `Jun-2023` + `Jul-2023` + `Aug-2023` + `Sep-2023` + `Oct-2023` + `Nov-2023` + `Dec-2023` +`Jan-2024` + `Feb-2024` + `Mar-2024` + `Apr-2024` + `May-2024` + `Jun-2024` + `Jul-2024` + `Aug-2024` + `Sep-2024` + `Oct-2024` + `Nov-2024` + `Dec-2024`) |>
      mutate(currentYearUsage = case_when(
        YOP == 2022 ~ usage22,
        YOP == 2023 ~ usage23,
        YOP == 2024 ~ usage24,
        .default = 0
      ),
      isCC22 = ifelse((YOP >= 2018 & YOP <= 2022) | YOP == 9999, 'Yes', 'No'),
      isCC23 = ifelse((YOP >= 2019 & YOP <= 2023) | YOP == 9999, 'Yes', 'No'),
      isCC24 = ifelse(YOP >= 2020, 'Yes', 'No'),
      isBackfile22 = ifelse(YOP > 1997 & YOP < 2018, 'Yes', 'No'),
      isBackfile23 = ifelse(YOP > 1997 & YOP < 2019, 'Yes', 'No'),
      isBackfile24 = ifelse(YOP > 1997 & YOP < 2020, 'Yes', 'No'),
      isTrueBackfile = ifelse(YOP <= 1997, 'Yes', 'No')
    )

    TR_J4_Complete <- rbind(TR_J4_Complete, oneTitle)
  }
}
```


```{r}
TR_J4_Complete_Check <- TR_J4_Complete |>
  distinct() |>
  mutate(ccClearanceUsage = case_when(
           isCC22 == 'Yes' & isCC23 == 'No' & isCC24 == 'No' ~ usage22,
           isCC22 == 'Yes' & isCC23 == 'Yes' & isCC24 == 'No' ~ usage22 + usage23,
           isCC22 == 'Yes' & isCC23 == 'Yes' & isCC24 == 'Yes' ~ usage22 + usage23 + usage24,
           isCC22 == 'No' & isCC23 == 'Yes' & isCC24 == 'Yes' ~ usage23 + usage24,
           isCC22 == 'No' & isCC23 == 'No' & isCC24 == 'Yes' ~ usage24,
           isCC22 == 'No' & isCC23 == 'No' & isCC24 == 'No' ~ 0,
           .default = NA
         ),
        backfileUsage = case_when(
           isBackfile22 == 'Yes' & isBackfile23 == 'No' & isBackfile24 == 'No' ~ usage22,
           isBackfile22 == 'Yes' & isBackfile23 == 'Yes' & isBackfile24 == 'No' ~ usage22 + usage23,
           isBackfile22 == 'Yes' & isBackfile23 == 'Yes' & isBackfile24 == 'Yes' ~ usage22 + usage23 + usage24,
           isBackfile22 == 'No' & isBackfile23 == 'Yes' & isBackfile24 == 'Yes' ~ usage23 + usage24,
           isBackfile22 == 'No' & isBackfile23 == 'No' & isBackfile24 == 'Yes' ~ usage24,
           isBackfile22 == 'No' & isBackfile23 == 'No' & isBackfile24 == 'No' ~ 0,
           .default = NA          
        ),
      trueBackfileUsage = ifelse(isTrueBackfile == 'Yes', Total_Usage, 0)) |>
  group_by(Title, Location) |>
  summarise(usage22 = sum(usage22),
            usage23 = sum(usage23),
            usage24 = sum(usage24),
            Total_Usage = sum(Total_Usage),
            currentYearUsage = sum(currentYearUsage),
            ccClearanceUsage = sum(ccClearanceUsage),
            backfileUsage = sum(backfileUsage),
            trueBackfileUsage = sum(trueBackfileUsage))


TR_J4_Complete_Check
```

```{r}
trA <- left_join(TR, fullInfo, by = c('Online_ISSN' = 'Digital ISSN', 'Title' = 'Title.x'))
trB <- left_join(trA, cleanReferencePrices, by = c('Location', 'ISBN'))
trC <- left_join(trB, cleanOnlineBooks, by = c('ISBN' = 'oISBN'))
trD <- left_join(trC, cleanWithdrawnList, by = c('ISBN' = 'oISBN'))
trE <- left_join(trD, openAccess, by = c('Online_ISSN' = 'Digital ISSN'))
trF <- left_join(trE, databaseModel, by = c('Acronym' = 'Journal Group code (alpha)')) |>
  filter(Metric_Type == 'Unique_Item_Requests') |>
  mutate(Price.y = ifelse(is.na(Price.y) == TRUE, 0, Price.y),
         actualRetailPrice = ifelse(is.na(actualRetailPrice) == TRUE, 0, actualRetailPrice),
         Price.x = ifelse(is.na(Price.x) == TRUE, 0, Price.x)) |>
  mutate(thePrice = Price.y + actualRetailPrice + Price.x) |>
  mutate(Resource_Type_Clean = case_when(
         `Hybrid Open Access` == 'Y' ~ 'Hybrid OA Journal',
         is.na(Resource_Type.x) == FALSE ~ 'Journal',
         is.na(Resource_Type.x.x) == FALSE ~ 'eBook',
         is.na(Resource_Type.y) == FALSE ~ 'Reference Work',
         is.na(Resource_Type.y.y) == FALSE ~ 'Withdrawn Title',
         is.na(Resource_Type.x.x.x) == FALSE ~ 'OA Journal',
         .default = 'Unknown')) |>
  mutate(isOA = case_when(
    Resource_Type_Clean == 'OA Journal' ~ 'Full OA',
    Resource_Type_Clean == 'Hybrid OA Journal' ~ 'Hybrid OA',
    .default = 'Not OA')) |>
  mutate(thePrice = ifelse(thePrice < 0.5, NA, thePrice),
         `Impact Factor 2023` = as.numeric(`Impact Factor 2023`)) |>
  mutate(thePrice = case_when(
    is.na(thePrice) == TRUE & Location == 'UT Knoxville' ~ 1453.80,
    is.na(thePrice) == TRUE & Location == 'Health Science' ~ 2965.25,
    is.na(thePrice) == TRUE & Location == 'Preston Medical Center' ~ 2955.43,
    is.na(thePrice) == TRUE & Location == 'UT Chattanooga' ~ 2658.24,
    .default = thePrice
  )) |>
  filter(!Title.x %in% fullRemoveList) |>
  filter(!Title.x %in% DR$Title)
```

```{r}
         actualRetailPrice = ifelse(is.na(actualRetailPrice) == TRUE, 0, actualRetailPrice),
         Price.x = ifelse(is.na(Price.x) == TRUE, 0, Price.x)) |>
  mutate(thePrice = Price.y + actualRetailPrice + Price.x) |>
  mutate(Resource_Type_Clean = case_when(
         `Hybrid Open Access` == 'Y' ~ 'Hybrid OA Journal',
         is.na(Resource_Type.x) == FALSE ~ 'Journal',
         is.na(Resource_Type.x.x) == FALSE ~ 'eBook',
         is.na(Resource_Type.y) == FALSE ~ 'Reference Work',
         is.na(Resource_Type.y.y) == FALSE ~ 'Withdrawn Title',
         is.na(Resource_Type.x.x.x) == FALSE ~ 'OA Journal',
         .default = 'Unknown')) |>
  mutate(isOA = case_when(
    Resource_Type_Clean == 'OA Journal' ~ 'Full OA',
    Resource_Type_Clean == 'Hybrid OA Journal' ~ 'Hybrid OA',
    .default = 'Not OA')) |>
  mutate(thePrice = ifelse(thePrice < 0.5, NA, thePrice),
         `Impact Factor 2023` = as.numeric(`Impact Factor 2023`)) |>
  mutate(thePrice = case_when(
    is.na(thePrice) == TRUE & Location == 'UT Knoxville' ~ 1453.80,
    is.na(thePrice) == TRUE & Location == 'Health Science' ~ 2965.25,
    is.na(thePrice) == TRUE & Location == 'Preston Medical Center' ~ 2955.43,
    is.na(thePrice) == TRUE & Location == 'UT Chattanooga' ~ 2658.24,
    .default = thePrice
  )) |>
  filter(Title.x %in% fullRemoveList)


TR_Separate <- data.frame()

titles <- unique(trF$Title.x)
locations <- unique(trF$Location)


for(i in 1:length(titles)){
    for(j in 1:length(locations)){
      title <- titles[i]
      location <- locations[j]
      
      titleData <- trF |>
        filter(Title.x == title & Location == location)
      
      if(dim(titleData)[1] == 0){
        next
      }

      oneTitle = data.frame(
        Title = title,
        Location = location,
        `Jan-2022` = sum(titleData$`Jan-2022`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Feb-2022` = sum(titleData$`Feb-2022`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Mar-2022` = sum(titleData$`Mar-2022`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Apr-2022` = sum(titleData$`Apr-2022`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `May-2022` = sum(titleData$`May-2022`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Jun-2022` = sum(titleData$`Jun-2022`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Jul-2022` = sum(titleData$`Jul-2022`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Aug-2022` = sum(titleData$`Aug-2022`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Sep-2022` = sum(titleData$`Sep-2022`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Oct-2022` = sum(titleData$`Oct-2022`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Nov-2022` = sum(titleData$`Nov-2022`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Dec-2022` = sum(titleData$`Dec-2022`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Jan-2023` = sum(titleData$`Jan-2023`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Feb-2023` = sum(titleData$`Feb-2023`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Mar-2023` = sum(titleData$`Mar-2023`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Apr-2023` = sum(titleData$`Apr-2023`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `May-2023` = sum(titleData$`May-2023`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Jun-2023` = sum(titleData$`Jun-2023`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Jul-2023` = sum(titleData$`Jul-2023`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Aug-2023` = sum(titleData$`Aug-2023`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Sep-2023` = sum(titleData$`Sep-2023`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Oct-2023` = sum(titleData$`Oct-2023`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Nov-2023` = sum(titleData$`Nov-2023`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Dec-2023` = sum(titleData$`Dec-2023`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Jan-2024` = sum(titleData$`Jan-2024`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Feb-2024` = sum(titleData$`Feb-2024`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Mar-2024` = sum(titleData$`Mar-2024`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Apr-2024` = sum(titleData$`Apr-2024`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `May-2024` = sum(titleData$`May-2024`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Jun-2024` = sum(titleData$`Jun-2024`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Jul-2024` = sum(titleData$`Jul-2024`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Aug-2024` = sum(titleData$`Aug-2024`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Sep-2024` = sum(titleData$`Sep-2024`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Oct-2024` = sum(titleData$`Oct-2024`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Nov-2024` = sum(titleData$`Nov-2024`, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Dec-2024` = sum(titleData$`Dec-2024`, na.rm = TRUE),
        usage22 = sum(titleData$`Jan-2022` + titleData$`Feb-2022` + titleData$`Mar-2022` + titleData$`Apr-2022` + titleData$`May-2022` + titleData$`Jun-2022` + titleData$`Jul-2022` + titleData$`Aug-2022` + titleData$`Sep-2022` + titleData$`Oct-2022` + titleData$`Nov-2022` + titleData$`Dec-2022`, na.rm = TRUE),
        usage23 = sum(titleData$`Jan-2023` + titleData$`Feb-2023` + titleData$`Mar-2023` + titleData$`Apr-2023` + titleData$`May-2023` + titleData$`Jun-2023` + titleData$`Jul-2023` + titleData$`Aug-2023` + titleData$`Sep-2023` + titleData$`Oct-2023` + titleData$`Nov-2023` + titleData$`Dec-2023`, na.rm = TRUE),
        usage24 = sum(titleData$`Jan-2024` + titleData$`Feb-2024` + titleData$`Mar-2024` + titleData$`Apr-2024` + titleData$`May-2024` + titleData$`Jun-2024` + titleData$`Jul-2024` + titleData$`Aug-2024` + titleData$`Sep-2024` + titleData$`Oct-2024` + titleData$`Nov-2024` + titleData$`Dec-2024`, na.rm = TRUE),
        Total_Usage = sum(titleData$Total_Usage, na.rm = TRUE),
        thePrice = mean(titleData$thePrice, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Impact_Factor_2023` = mean(titleData$`Impact Factor 2023`, na.rm = TRUE),
        Resource_Type_Clean = titleData$Resource_Type_Clean[1],
        costPerUse = (mean(titleData$thePrice, na.rm = TRUE) / (sum(titleData$Total_Usage, na.rm = TRUE) / 3)),
        costUseBucket = case_when(
          (mean(titleData$thePrice, na.rm = TRUE) / (sum(titleData$Total_Usage, na.rm = TRUE) / 3)) >= 20 ~ 'Over $20',
          (mean(titleData$thePrice, na.rm = TRUE) / (sum(titleData$Total_Usage, na.rm = TRUE) / 3)) < 20 ~ 'Under $20',
          titleData$Resource_Type_Clean[1] == 'Withdrawn Title' ~ 'Withdrawn Title',
          titleData$Resource_Type_Clean[1] == 'OA Journal' ~ 'Full Open Access'
        ),
        `Full_Collection` = ifelse(is.na(titleData$`Full Collection`) == FALSE, 'Yes', 'No'),
        `STM_Collection` = ifelse(is.na(titleData$`STM Collection`) == FALSE, 'Yes', 'No'),
        `SSH_Collection` = ifelse(is.na(titleData$`SSH Collection`) == FALSE, 'Yes', 'No'),
        `MN_Collection` = ifelse(is.na(titleData$`M&N Collection`) == FALSE, 'Yes', 'No'),
        `Database_Collection` = ifelse(is.na(titleData$`Database Collection`) == FALSE, 'Yes', 'No'),
        `Unknown_Collection` = ifelse(titleData$Resource_Type_Clean == 'Unknown', 'Yes', 'No')
      )

      TR_Separate <- rbind(TR_Separate, oneTitle)
  }
}

TR_Separate <- TR_Separate |>
  distinct()



TR_Separate
```

# TR_Complete: Usage by Package



```{r}
TR_Package_Usage <- TR_Complete |>
  group_by(Location) |>
  summarise(numTitles = n(),
            fullCollectionTitles = sum(ifelse(`Full_Collection` == 'Yes', 1, 0)),
            stmCollectionTitles = sum(ifelse(`STM_Collection` == 'Yes', 1, 0)),
            sshCollectionTitles = sum(ifelse(`SSH_Collection` == 'Yes', 1, 0)),
            mnCollectionTitles = sum(ifelse(`MN_Collection` == 'Yes', 1, 0)),
            databaseCollectionTitles = sum(ifelse(`Database_Collection` == 'Yes', 1, 0)),
            unknownWithdrawnTitles = sum(ifelse(Resource_Type_Clean %in% c('Withdrawn Title', 'Unknown'), 1, 0)),
            oaTitles = sum(ifelse(Resource_Type_Clean == 'OA Journal', 1, 0)),
            othereBookTitles = sum(ifelse(Resource_Type_Clean == 'eBook' & `Database_Collection` == 'No', 1, 0)),
            otherReferenceTitles = sum(ifelse(Resource_Type_Clean == 'Reference Work' & `Database_Collection` == 'No', 1, 0)),
            totalUsage = sum(usage22 + usage23 + usage24),
            fullCollectionUsage = sum(ifelse(Full_Collection == 'Yes', Total_Usage, 0)),
            stmCollectionUsage = sum(ifelse(STM_Collection == 'Yes', Total_Usage, 0)),
            sshCollectionUsage = sum(ifelse(SSH_Collection == 'Yes', Total_Usage, 0)),
            mnCollectionUsage = sum(ifelse(MN_Collection == 'Yes', Total_Usage, 0)),
            databaseCollectionUsage = sum(ifelse(Database_Collection == 'Yes', Total_Usage, 0)),
            unknownWithdrawnCollectionUsage = sum(ifelse(Resource_Type_Clean %in% c('Withdrawn Title', 'Unknown'), Total_Usage, 0)),
            oaCollectionUsage = sum(ifelse(Resource_Type_Clean == 'OA Journal', Total_Usage, 0)),
            othereBookCollectionUsage = sum(ifelse(Resource_Type_Clean == 'eBook' & `Database_Collection` == 'No', Total_Usage, 0)),
            otherReferenceCollectionUsage = sum(ifelse(Resource_Type_Clean == 'Reference Work' & `Database_Collection` == 'No', Total_Usage, 0))) |>
  mutate(fullCollectionTitlePerc = round(100.0*fullCollectionTitles / numTitles, 1),
         stmCollectionTitlePerc = round(100.0*stmCollectionTitles / numTitles, 1),
         sshCollectionTitlePerc = round(100.0*sshCollectionTitles / numTitles, 1),
         mnCollectionTitlePerc = round(100.0*mnCollectionTitles / numTitles, 1),
         databaseCollectionTitlePerc = round(100.0*databaseCollectionTitles / numTitles, 1),
         unknownWithdrawnTitlePerc = round(100.0*unknownWithdrawnTitles / numTitles, 1),
         oaTitlePerc = round(100.0*oaTitles / numTitles, 1),
         othereBookTitlePerc = round(100.0*othereBookTitles / numTitles, 1),
         otherReferenceTitlePerc = round(100.0*otherReferenceTitles / numTitles, 1))

TR_Package_Usage
```
